_doc: Forest set pieces, round 4 (ADR-0053): props of the Ridge Relay Hut (w4_ridge_relay_hut), an unmanned microwave relay hut on a forested ridge: the concrete equipment shelter's racks, battery bank and propane generator, the 20 m guyed tower with its dishes and platform railings, the fenced compound's propane tank, fuel shed and gate, and the helipad. Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_wild4_relay.py -> models/props/<id>[_worn|_destroyed].glb; catalog tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/props_wild4_relay.py. Materials are shared sets (no new ones). size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z); PoiBuilder's collision box is the size centred over the origin. Floor props stand on their origin with their depth centred on it (back = half the depth); the tower stands at the platforms' centre and the dish at the foot of its mount pipe.

defs.name: Guyed Relay Tower
defs.description: A 20 m guyed lattice tower, 2.2 m square, galvanised and rust-streaked: K-braced faces, the platform frames every 3 m round the POI's kit platforms, an antenna whip and a dead red beacon on top, a coax ladder of feeder cables down one leg and four guy wires to concrete anchors 6.5 m out (worn: a guy slack and coiled on the ground, a brace hanging). Origin at the platforms' centre on the ground. Only its four legs collide (to the top platform): the kit platforms and their railings carry the climber; the wires are walked under.

defs.name: Spare Tower Section
defs.description: A spare 3 m section of lattice mast, 1 m square, lying on its side on two timber sleepers where the crane truck left it, splice plates and a bag of bolts wired to one end (worn: rusted, the bag split).

defs.name: Microwave Dish
defs.description: A 1.2 m microwave relay dish under a grey fabric radome on a galvanised pipe mount with its two clamp brackets, a stiff-arm and the elliptical waveguide looping off the back (worn: the radome split and flapping, the dish knocked off its aim). Origin at the foot of its mount pipe on the platform edge; the dish hangs out over the railing toward the front. Collision none.

defs.name: Equipment Rack
defs.description: A 19-inch relay rack bolted to the floor: radio shelves with their faceplates and dead LEDs, a patch panel spilling jumpers, a fan tray and the coax entering through the top (worn: panels pulled, a shelf hanging; destroyed: gutted, the cards on the floor).

defs.name: Battery Bank
defs.description: A two-tier steel rack of big grey standby cells strapped in rows, bus bars and cables along the top, a spill tray and a hydrometer hung on the end (worn: a cell cracked and white with corrosion).

defs.name: Propane Tank
defs.description: A 500-gallon white propane tank on concrete saddles: the dome lid over the regulator and the float gauge, a pipe down to the ground into the shelter's line and a warning stencil (worn: the paint chalked and rust-bloomed, the dome lid off and the gauge on red).

defs.name: Propane Generator
defs.description: A standby generator in a grey louvred enclosure on a concrete pad: the hinged lid, the control panel with its hour meter and run lamp, the propane line in through a flex hose and the exhaust out through the wall (worn: the lid up, a plug lead off and the meter stopped).

defs.name: Helipad
defs.description: A square concrete helipad set into the ridge, its edge painted white, a yellow H in a white circle, tie-down rings at the corners and moss in the joints (worn: the paint flaking and a crack across the H). It stands 15 cm proud: walked on.

defs.name: Platform Railing
defs.description: 1 m of galvanised angle railing with a mid rail and a toe board, along a tower platform's open edge so a climber can't step off (worn: the mid rail bent out).

defs.name: Fuel Shed
defs.description: A low corrugated shed on a timber frame with a padlock hasp hanging open: shelves of oil, spare filters, a gas can and the propane hose kit; a NO SMOKING board on the door (worn: the door off a hinge).

defs.name: Compound Gate
defs.description: A chain-link gate leaf on its own galvanised post, swung open and held back against the fence by a twist of wire, its chain and open padlock hanging from the latch.

defs.name: Field Radio
defs.description: An olive-drab Cordon field radio set on its battery box: the handset on its curly cord, a whip antenna taped to the railing, a frequency card under a rubber band (worn: the handset down on its cord).

defs.name: Cable Reel
defs.description: A plywood cable drum on its rim with a few turns of black coax left on it, chocked with a brick.

defs.name: Windsock
defs.description: An orange windsock on a hinged galvanised pole beside the helipad (worn: the sock torn to a rag). The collision box is the pole.
